entries.title: Ajv strict mode throws on unknown keywords
entries.body: By default Ajv runs in strict mode: unknown keywords throw at compile time (or log with strict:'log'). Disabling via strict:false silently ignores mistakes—avoid for production schemas where typos would otherwise fail open.

entries.title: Ajv compiles and caches schemas by stable string
entries.body: Ajv compiles schemas to optimized JS functions and caches them by the JSON-stable-stringified key. Reuse the compiled validate function (compile/getSchema) for best performance; the errors array is overwritten on each call.

entries.title: $data references read values from the instance
entries.body: Ajv's $data option enables $data references so a keyword's value is taken from the data being validated. It requires the Draft 6 meta-schema extension; with another meta-schema use $dataMetaSchema to add support.

entries.title: strictNumbers rejects NaN and Infinity
entries.body: With strictNumbers:true (default), Ajv fails validation if NaN or Infinity is supplied where a number is expected. Disabling allows them but diverges from safe JSON number handling and RFC 8259.

entries.title: formats require ajv-formats opt-in
entries.body: Ajv does not assert format by default. Install ajv-formats and enable via addFormats or validateFormats:true. Unknown formats throw at compile time in strict mode.

entries.title: Ajv fully supports unevaluatedProperties / Items
entries.body: Ajv implements unevaluatedProperties and unevaluatedItems (2020-12), correctly considering allOf/anyOf/oneOf branches. This enables strict closed-object validation that additionalProperties alone cannot provide.

entries.title: coerceTypes can mutate validated data
entries.body: coerceTypes:true attempts to coerce data to the schema type (e.g. '123' to 123). It modifies the data in place—use with care, because it changes the input payload the caller holds.

entries.title: useDefaults assigns missing properties
entries.body: With useDefaults:true, Ajv assigns default values to missing properties/items during validation, mutating the data. Strict mode fails compilation for certain ignored-default cases.

entries.title: allowUnionTypes for multiple types in `type`
entries.body: Ajv's strictTypes warns/throws when `type` lists multiple non-null types (e.g. ["string","null"]). Set allowUnionTypes:true to permit it intentionally—common in OpenAPI 3.1 nullable patterns.

entries.title: allErrors collects every validation error
entries.body: By default Ajv returns after the first error. Set allErrors:true to collect all errors (slower compile, more diagnostics). Copy the errors array reference if used asynchronously, as it is overwritten each call.
